verdict.rationale: Gaming performance is a fair question for a high-end GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no vendor claims about game frame rates and no independent game benchmarks. The closest items are adjacent capabilities: DLSS 4 for rendering, DisplayPort 2.1 driving displays up to 8K at 240Hz, and tools that help developers test their games. None of these shows the card actually delivers high-refresh 4K gameplay, and community items cover AI workloads, hardware defects and pricing rather than gaming.
